headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of August 25, 2026, the portfolio is showing a year-to-date return of 24.19%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 12.92%. This results in an average alpha of 11.27%, indicating that the portfolio is not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered an impressive return of 45.63%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 9.71%, which is still above the benchmark but highlights the variability within the portfolio. Outperformance against SPY is particularly relevant during periods of market stress, as it reflects the portfolio's resilience and ability to capitalize on favorable conditions. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
